description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which extends Android's Fragment class. It manages a UI component that displays log data using a custom LogView within a ScrollView. The class includes methods for initializing the view hierarchy, inflating views, and handling layout and text change events to facilitate real-time log display in an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays log data in a scrollable, monospace text view, suitable for debugging or displaying runtime logs in an Android application.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView with specified padding, layout parameters, and styling, returning the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, sets up a text watcher to auto-scroll on log updates, and returns the view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor method returning the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
